Frequently Asked Questions

How does AlliedFencing.com get transferred to me?

After payment is completed for AlliedFencing.com, we’ll guide you through the best available
transfer option based on the domain’s current registrar and extension.

For most domains, we’ll seamlessly move the domain to your Atom account. If the domain extension is
not yet supported or there is an exception, we can typically assist with either a registrar account
push or by providing an authorization (auth) code so you can transfer the domain to your preferred
registrar.

Does AlliedFencing.com come with Trademark or Business Registration?

AlliedFencing.com and other names on Atom Marketplace do not include Trademarks or business
registration. This is because Trademarks are unique to the industry (class) as well as country of
the business. Since AlliedFencing.com can be purchased by anyone for any use, it would not be
possible for us to file a Trademark in advance.

We recommend that you do some research and/or seek legal advice to ensure that the name you are
interested in does not have a direct Trademark conflict by a competitor in your industry and within
your region. If there is no direct conflict, or the existing trademark is unrelated to how you plan
to use it, then you have a good chance of being able to trademark the name yourself. If there is an
existing trademark, keep in mind that, as long as your business is in a different industry, you may
still be able to file a trademark for the name.

We also offer a Trademark validation & Filing service which includes upfront Trademark validation
and filing the Trademark application on your behalf by a licensed Trademark Attorney.

What is your refund policy?

Domains purchased on our platform are generally non-refundable. Because domain transfers are
typically instant or near-instant, refunds cannot be issued once a domain transfer has been
initiated or completed.

If a domain has not yet been transferred, a refund may be considered only if all of the following
conditions are met:
* The refund request is made on the same day as the purchase
* The domain transfer has not been initiated (including registrar push or transfer-out)
* The domain was purchased with a one-time payment (not installments)

If a refund is approved under these conditions, it may be subject to a cancellation fee to cover
payment processing costs.

Are there any ongoing costs after I purchase the Domain?

The purchase price of a domain on our marketplace is a one-time payment. Once the domain is
transferred to your account, you will own it.

To keep the domain active, you’ll need to renew it each year through your domain registrar. Renewal
fees vary by registrar and domain extension. For example, .com domains typically renew for around
$10–$20 per year, while other extensions such as .io, .xyz, or .ai may cost more.

To avoid accidental expiration, we recommend keeping a valid credit card on file with your registrar
and enabling auto-renewal so your domain renews automatically each year.

How safe is the purchase process?

All domain purchases are backed by our Purchase Protection Guarantee. With over 100,000 customers
worldwide, Atom has been featured in the Inc 5000 list of fastest growing companies for 4
consecutive years.

We initiate most domain transfers within 1 Business day of purchase. If, for any reason, we are
unable to transfer the domain to your ownership, we offer a 100% refund.

How does Lease to Own work?

Some domains on our marketplace offer Lease to Own plans, allowing you to purchase a domain through
smaller monthly payments instead of paying the full amount upfront.

You can begin using the domain after your first payment. The domain will remain securely held with
Atom until all payments are completed, and our team can assist with any domain setting changes while
the Lease to Own plan is active.

Once the Lease to Own plan has been paid in full, the domain will be transferred to your ownership.

If your plans change, you can cancel the Lease to Own plan at any time. Learn more about how Lease
to Own plans work in our detailed guide: [How Lease to Own Works.][105]

Frequently Asked Questions

How does AlliedFencing.com get transferred to me?

After payment is completed for AlliedFencing.com, we’ll guide you through the best available
transfer option based on the domain’s current registrar and extension.

For most domains, we’ll seamlessly move the domain to your Atom account. If the domain extension is
not yet supported or there is an exception, we can typically assist with either a registrar account
push or by providing an authorization (auth) code so you can transfer the domain to your preferred
registrar.

Does AlliedFencing.com come with Trademark or Business Registration?

AlliedFencing.com and other names on Atom Marketplace do not include Trademarks or business
registration. This is because Trademarks are unique to the industry (class) as well as country of
the business. Since AlliedFencing.com can be purchased by anyone for any use, it would not be
possible for us to file a Trademark in advance.

We recommend that you do some research and/or seek legal advice to ensure that the name you are
interested in does not have a direct Trademark conflict by a competitor in your industry and within
your region. If there is no direct conflict, or the existing trademark is unrelated to how you plan
to use it, then you have a good chance of being able to trademark the name yourself. If there is an
existing trademark, keep in mind that, as long as your business is in a different industry, you may
still be able to file a trademark for the name.

We also offer a Trademark validation & Filing service which includes upfront Trademark validation
and filing the Trademark application on your behalf by a licensed Trademark Attorney.

What is your refund policy?

Domains purchased on our platform are generally non-refundable. Because domain transfers are
typically instant or near-instant, refunds cannot be issued once a domain transfer has been
initiated or completed.

If a domain has not yet been transferred, a refund may be considered only if all of the following
conditions are met:
* The refund request is made on the same day as the purchase
* The domain transfer has not been initiated (including registrar push or transfer-out)
* The domain was purchased with a one-time payment (not installments)

If a refund is approved under these conditions, it may be subject to a cancellation fee to cover
payment processing costs.

Are there any ongoing costs after I purchase the Domain?

The purchase price of a domain on our marketplace is a one-time payment. Once the domain is
transferred to your account, you will own it.

To keep the domain active, you’ll need to renew it each year through your domain registrar. Renewal
fees vary by registrar and domain extension. For example, .com domains typically renew for around
$10–$20 per year, while other extensions such as .io, .xyz, or .ai may cost more.

To avoid accidental expiration, we recommend keeping a valid credit card on file with your registrar
and enabling auto-renewal so your domain renews automatically each year.

How safe is the purchase process?

All domain purchases are backed by our Purchase Protection Guarantee. With over 100,000 customers
worldwide, Atom has been featured in the Inc 5000 list of fastest growing companies for 4
consecutive years.

We initiate most domain transfers within 1 Business day of purchase. If, for any reason, we are
unable to transfer the domain to your ownership, we offer a 100% refund.

How does Lease to Own work?

Some domains on our marketplace offer Lease to Own plans, allowing you to purchase a domain through
smaller monthly payments instead of paying the full amount upfront.

You can begin using the domain after your first payment. The domain will remain securely held with
Atom until all payments are completed, and our team can assist with any domain setting changes while
the Lease to Own plan is active.

Once the Lease to Own plan has been paid in full, the domain will be transferred to your ownership.

If your plans change, you can cancel the Lease to Own plan at any time. Learn more about how Lease
to Own plans work in our detailed guide: [How Lease to Own Works.][105]

Home aluminum fence or pool fences are the perfect addition to any property. Whether you are looking
to add security for your home or pool, improve their physical appeal or let your pet roam the
backyard without running away, pool fences and home aluminum fencing are wonderful options. There is
no price tag on peace of mind and having a good fence in or around your yard is a great way to make
that happen.

### Boost Your Home Value

Not only are pool fencing and home aluminum fences stylish, but they also increase your property
value. An aluminum fence or a pool fence provides a terrific ROI, and our customers can save even
more money with do-it-yourself installation. Our aluminum fencing and pool fencing are easy to
install and can be done in a weekend, so you don’t have to worry about paying a contractor for
overpriced materials or labor. You know exactly what you’re getting with our aluminum fencing, when
you’re getting it, and how to get it installed and protecting your property. It’s a nice thing to
not have to worry about any guesswork, particularly when it comes to the bottom line.

### Maintenance-free Fencing Solution

Unlike other fencing materials, aluminum fencing does not rust or rot. Our aluminum fences are built
to withstand any elements! Install your residential, commercial or industrial pool fences now and
don’t worry about cleaning, preservative treatments, termite protection or other maintenance needs
that other fences require. You simply install your aluminum fence, let it stand and stop worrying
about it for years at a time.

commercial and industrial grades available as well! Our traditional residential [aluminum
fencing][116] sections have the ability to adjust [(rack)][117] up a slope, 16 inches for every 6
foot wide panel or up to 29 inches with our free double punched option. We understand that every
fencing environment is going to be a bit different. Some homes and businesses are on hilly lots,
others will need fencing around concrete and still others are going to be built on top of soil. We
make sure our aluminum fencing is such that you won’t have to worry about where it’s going – just
follow our instructions and you’ll be all set in no time, protecting what’s yours in a stylish
manner.

All orders are customized to your specific requirements. Our more popular aluminum fence styles

[Sierra][122] styles) are available to ship in about [**2 weeks**][123]. We’ll be happy to walk you

## Residential, Commercial & Industrial Wholesale Aluminum Fences

Home aluminum fence or pool fences are the perfect addition to any property. Whether you are looking
to add security for your home or pool, improve their physical appeal or let your pet roam the
backyard without running away, pool fences and home aluminum fencing are wonderful options. There is
no price tag on peace of mind and having a good fence in or around your yard is a great way to make
that happen.

### Boost Your Home Value

Not only are pool fencing and home aluminum fences stylish, but they also increase your property
value. An aluminum fence or a pool fence provides a terrific ROI, and our customers can save even
more money with do-it-yourself installation. Our aluminum fencing and pool fencing are easy to
install and can be done in a weekend, so you don’t have to worry about paying a contractor for
overpriced materials or labor. You know exactly what you’re getting with our aluminum fencing, when
you’re getting it, and how to get it installed and protecting your property. It’s a nice thing to
not have to worry about any guesswork, particularly when it comes to the bottom line.

### Maintenance-free Fencing Solution

Unlike other fencing materials, aluminum fencing does not rust or rot. Our aluminum fences are built
to withstand any elements! Install your residential, commercial or industrial pool fences now and
don’t worry about cleaning, preservative treatments, termite protection or other maintenance needs
that other fences require. You simply install your aluminum fence, let it stand and stop worrying
about it for years at a time.

### Customizable Aluminum Fence Options

The styles that you’ll see here are **6′ wide** residential grade sections, but we also have
commercial and industrial grades available as well! Our traditional residential [aluminum
fencing][116] sections have the ability to adjust [(rack)][117] up a slope, 16 inches for every 6
foot wide panel or up to 29 inches with our free double punched option. We understand that every
fencing environment is going to be a bit different. Some homes and businesses are on hilly lots,
others will need fencing around concrete and still others are going to be built on top of soil. We
make sure our aluminum fencing is such that you won’t have to worry about where it’s going – just
follow our instructions and you’ll be all set in no time, protecting what’s yours in a stylish
manner.

All orders are customized to your specific requirements. Our more popular aluminum fence styles
(residential grade [Floridian][118], [Manhattan][119], [Appalachian][120], [Outback][121] and
[Sierra][122] styles) are available to ship in about [**2 weeks**][123]. We’ll be happy to walk you
through that process as well, so that your measurements are accurate and you won’t have to worry
about making something fit.

## Frequently Asked Questions

##### How do I place an order?

Either fill out the **[Order Form][131]** and fax it or email it in on our **[Get a
Quote][132]** page and we’ll start the order process by contacting you via email with a confirmation
quotation.  You can also send us a drawing of where the fence is going on your property via
our **[Layout Form][133] **or just email us a drawing with dimensions of each straight line and
we'll send a material list and price quotation of what you'll need.

##### What is the importance of sending a layout form?

The importance is that every fence and every backyard is unique. The Layout Form allows us to
provide an accurate quote that lists all the material along with any freight charges if your order
does not qualify for Free Freight. Orders that do not qualify for free freight are based on weight
and shipping zip code, not total price.

##### How far do you deliver to?

We’ll send our aluminum fences anywhere in the continental United States, but for logistical
reasons, states west of Texas, Oklahoma, Missouri and Illinois may have higher shipping costs. We’ll
include these costs with your free estimate.

##### Are sections & gates assembled?

All sections & gates are shipped assembled. Certain styles require finials and/or loops to be
installed in the field.

## FAQs

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your

Engineered for reliable, concealed performance in mass‑timber construction, Timber‑SET^{™} epoxy
brings ICC‑ES‑evaluated strength to glued‑in‑rod (GIR) connections in glulam. Its tested formulation

### [Who Is Alaska Farm Supply?][35]

Alaska Farm Supply is a veteran family owned and operated company. Our goal is to help Alaskans
create growing farms by providing equipment to safely protect valuable livestock and property. We do
this by offering quality farm equipment at affordable prices.

[Read more][36]

### [All Products][37]

All Alaska Farm Supply products are from our US and Canadian factories, our own factory distribution
center or and/or manufactured and assembled by Alaska Farm Supply directly. We always provide our
customers the lowest possible prices, with quality in mind and understand the financial

[Read more][38]

### [Contact Information][39]

Get in touch and we’ll get baa-aaa-ack to you as soon as we can. We look forward to hearing from
you!

[Read more][40]

### Search This Website

Search
Search

### How We Serve You

Alaska Farm Supply is a veteran owned and operated family business. We offer wholesale and retail
sales.

Customers can obtain delivery or pick up products at our Palmer warehouse. After a small credit card
deposit is placed, we tag and store the products for you at absolutely no charge.

We at Alaska Farm Supply understand the geographic challenges many of our customers face across
Alaska. That's why we continue to store products for free up to 30 days or up to 90 days based on
your geographic location, until it's convenient for you to make the trip to Palmer.

### Payment and Delivery

**Delivery:** We consolidate orders to save money for our customers. **[Delivery service][41]** is
available to the Anchorage metro area, Mat-su Valley, and most parts of the Glenn and Richardson
Highways for a minimal charge.

**Orders:** If an item is not currently in stock, Alaska Farm Supply can still obtain it for you and
have it shipped to our Palmer warehouse for FREE. A $100 deposit or 25% of the total purchase is
required for all orders. Payment in full is required upon delivery or pickup and at that time, all
sales are final.

**Payment:** We accept all major credit cards, money orders, cash and checks from Alaskan nonprofits
and businesses. Personal checks are not accepted.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Installation Process

Every job differs in size and scope. However, as fencing contractors, we typically follow the
[steps][74] below:
* Day one – Set the posts in concrete (unless stated otherwise)
* Allow three to five business days for the concrete to cure. We use that time to build the gates as
  well.
* Final day – Stretch the wire and install any gates.

In general, if we set the posts on Monday, the job is usually done by Thursday or Friday, unless we
are working with custom vinyl gates that get powder coated. Powder coated gates can take an
additional week or two.

## Are Your Prices Competitive?

Our pricing is one of the top reasons why we sell more fences than ALL other fence installers in the
High Desert area. Prices often directly impact your sales. We constantly reinvest in our business in
ways that allow us to maintain low prices yet still uphold high quality and standards. As long as
the competing fencing contractors have equal certifications and licenses, we often beat their
prices.

## What’s the Warranty on Your Fences?

As a [reputable fencing contractor][75], we offer a three-year warranty on material, excluding the
gate hardware, and a one-year warranty on our installations or workmanship. However, these do not
apply in cases of vandalism, natural disasters, vehicular or animal damage, and normal wear and
tear. Powder or vinyl-coated material is also not covered. Our warranties may change without notice.

## Do You Make Vinyl Ranch Style Gates, Swing or Rolling?

Vinyl gates have always been a problem due to their durability issues. As a result, our High Desert
fence installers and product developers came up with a steel design that resembles a vinyl gate and
is powder-coated to match the ranch-style vinyl fence. This is a customer favorite for its
durability and aesthetics. However, fencing contractors also use chain link gates with vinyl fences.
It’s a cheaper option.

## What if I want the Fence Over My Concrete Patio or Sidewalk, Etc.?

We are professional fencing contractors, and dealing with unconventional situations is part of our
daily work. If we have to set posts over concrete, we can use a core drill bit to make a hole in the
concrete and set a post inside. Alternatively, we can go for a post with welded base plates at the
bottom, so we only need to bolt the plate to the concrete.

## Does Your Company Cement the Posts in the Ground?

Yes, 99.9% of the time, our fencing company places our posts in holes and casts concrete surrounds
in the ground. In very rare instances, fencing contractors dirt-set at the client’s request. This is
often for temporary projects where the customer wants the cost to be as low as possible.

## Will My Fence Rust?

All the chain link products and materials we stock are galvanized to prevent rusting. Depending on
the area’s climate and how often the fence absorbs impact, it could go for decades without rusting.

contractors and builders completing most projects between two to four days after initial
post-setting.

All American Fence Erectors is a fencing company you can trust to meet all your fencing needs. [Call
us today at (760) 948-2428][72] to schedule a time to get a free estimate and experience
professional service and fencing that can stand the test of time!

## HOW IT WORKS

At All American Fence Erectors, we ensure a smooth and efficient experience from start to finish;
that’s why we’re the top choice for a fencing company in the High Desert area of Southern
California.
* ### Contact Us
  
  Call us Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
* ### Get Your Free Estimate
  
  We provide a free, detailed, and comprehensive quote based on your needs.
* ### Schedule a Time
  
  We’ll arrange a start date that fits your schedule.
* ### Get Your Professional Installation
  
  We keep customers informed and up-to-date on our installations.

[CONTACT US NOW FOR PROFESSIONAL FENCING INSTALLATION][73]

## FENCING CONTRACTORS YOU CAN TRUST

Interested in how we stack up against the competition? If you’re in the High Desert area, just look
up “fencing contractors near me” or take a look at some of our reviews and trust badges below to see
why we’re the preeminent fencing company in Southern California!
* **40+ Years of Experience**
* **Licensed and Insured**
* **Family-owned and Operated**
* **Brick-and-mortar Business**
* **4.6 Stars Google reviews**

 

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Installation Process

Every job differs in size and scope. However, as fencing contractors, we typically follow the
[steps][74] below:
* Day one – Set the posts in concrete (unless stated otherwise)
* Allow three to five business days for the concrete to cure. We use that time to build the gates as
  well.
* Final day – Stretch the wire and install any gates.

In general, if we set the posts on Monday, the job is usually done by Thursday or Friday, unless we
are working with custom vinyl gates that get powder coated. Powder coated gates can take an
additional week or two.

## Are Your Prices Competitive?

Our pricing is one of the top reasons why we sell more fences than ALL other fence installers in the
High Desert area. Prices often directly impact your sales. We constantly reinvest in our business in
ways that allow us to maintain low prices yet still uphold high quality and standards. As long as
the competing fencing contractors have equal certifications and licenses, we often beat their
prices.

## What’s the Warranty on Your Fences?

As a [reputable fencing contractor][75], we offer a three-year warranty on material, excluding the
gate hardware, and a one-year warranty on our installations or workmanship. However, these do not
apply in cases of vandalism, natural disasters, vehicular or animal damage, and normal wear and
tear. Powder or vinyl-coated material is also not covered. Our warranties may change without notice.

## Do You Make Vinyl Ranch Style Gates, Swing or Rolling?

Vinyl gates have always been a problem due to their durability issues. As a result, our High Desert
fence installers and product developers came up with a steel design that resembles a vinyl gate and
is powder-coated to match the ranch-style vinyl fence. This is a customer favorite for its
durability and aesthetics. However, fencing contractors also use chain link gates with vinyl fences.
It’s a cheaper option.

## What if I want the Fence Over My Concrete Patio or Sidewalk, Etc.?

We are professional fencing contractors, and dealing with unconventional situations is part of our
daily work. If we have to set posts over concrete, we can use a core drill bit to make a hole in the
concrete and set a post inside. Alternatively, we can go for a post with welded base plates at the
bottom, so we only need to bolt the plate to the concrete.

## Does Your Company Cement the Posts in the Ground?

Yes, 99.9% of the time, our fencing company places our posts in holes and casts concrete surrounds
in the ground. In very rare instances, fencing contractors dirt-set at the client’s request. This is
often for temporary projects where the customer wants the cost to be as low as possible.

## Will My Fence Rust?

All the chain link products and materials we stock are galvanized to prevent rusting. Depending on
the area’s climate and how often the fence absorbs impact, it could go for decades without rusting.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

# Commercial Perimeter Security

AMAROK has been protecting commercial properties since 1973. Our mission is to protect your property
by stopping crime before it happens with our integrated security-as-a-service solutions.

Today, over 9,000 happy customers enjoy AMAROK-level protection.

## Integrated Electric Fencing Solutions. Built for You. Maintained by Us.

The foundation of AMAROK is [The Electric Guard Dog® Fence][72], which prevents 99% of external
theft for our customers. When you choose AMAROK, you’ll connect with one of our perimeter security
experts, who will conduct a [free risk assessment][73] of your commercial property to discover the
vulnerabilities you don’t see (but criminals do).

Our team will partner with you to integrate any combination of our perimeter security solutions,
including [video surveillance][74], [remote monitoring][75], and [Gate Access Control][76],
integrated with our [electric fencing solutions][77] for multi-layered protection. We handle all
compliance requirements and install your tailored perimeter security system with zero upfront fees,
just one manageable monthly subscription.

## Highly Effective

Delivering 7,000 volts of pulsed electric shock every 1.3 seconds, AMAROK’s imposing electric fences
prevent 99% of external theft after installation. On top of that, our streamlined monthly pricing
and zero upfront costs make security cost-effective right now.

## Always Ready

Smart criminals know how to exploit perimeter blind spots. We help you be smarter with monitored
solutions for constant and proactive security. Nothing protects like an electric fence. No one
protects like AMAROK.

## Maintenance-Free

We handle everything, from maintenance and upgrades to ensuring your electric fencing complies with
local regulations. Our team is available 24/7, and our average service turnaround time is just 1.3
days.

## Liability Insured

# Antebellum Manufacturing – Aluminum Fencing & Railing

Antebellum Manufacturing manufactures high-quality aluminum fencing and railing in Ocala, Florida.
We use U.S. extrusions and handle all fabrication in-house to ensure quality, consistency, and
reliable lead times. We support a national network of stocking distributors and work closely with
architects and contractors. Every order is backed by dependable service, accurate fulfillment, and
long-term product performance. Our team is responsive, experienced, and focused on customer success.


At Antebellum Manufacturing we proudly deliver aluminum fencing and railing solutions for projects
across the United States, serving a wide range of applications from residential communities to
large-scale commercial and industrial sites. Our systems have been trusted on high-profile and
technically demanding ventures, including aerospace facilities like SpaceX, police stations,
universities, theme parks, and automotive plants, demonstrating the strength, reliability, and
precision of our American-made products.


[Ant Mfg Pics (29).jpg]
[Antebellum Manufacturing Plant]
[Antebellum Alum Fence.jpg]
[Antebellum Louver Patio.png]

Antebellum Manufacturing is a manufacturing company composed of partners and associates dedicated to
providing the best quality service and best quality products in the Aluminum Fence, Gate and Rail
Market.

Every order is backed by dependable service, accurate fulfillment, and long-term product
performance. Our team is responsive, experienced, and focused on customer success.

###### Our Mission

Our manufacturing facility is both family-owned and locally operated. We take pride in our products
and are dedicated to providing our customers with the finest American-made aluminum fencing, gates,
and rails.

[Antebellum Mfg Alum Fence]
[Antebellum Mfg Gate]

###### Fence Styles

Our fence styles are inspired by the names of our children, reflecting the pride we take in crafting
your fence, just as you will.


[Check out our fence styles][54]

### Deliver Projects With Confidence

#### Reliable Wholesale Fencing Supply Backed by Manufacturing

Barrier Fencing Supply Company is a leading wholesale fencing manufacturer and distributor serving
contractors, dealers, builders, and developers throughout North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia,
and the Southeast. With in-house vinyl fence manufacturing and extensive distribution capabilities,
we provide dependable access to premium fencing materials backed by consistent inventory,
competitive pricing, and responsive customer support.



Our product offering includes vinyl fencing, aluminum fencing, chain link fencing, wood fencing,
commercial and industrial fencing systems, vinyl railing and handrail products, custom gates and
entry systems, agricultural and equine fencing, custom stall systems, barn components, jump
standards, arenas, and a full range of fencing accessories. Whether you're supplying a residential
installation, commercial development, municipal project, or agricultural facility, we have the
products and capacity to keep your project moving.



Every product is selected or manufactured to deliver long-term durability, reliable performance, and
professional installation. Our manufacturing capabilities allow us to maintain greater quality
control, improve lead times, and offer flexible solutions that meet the demands of today's
contractors and distributors.



From single truckload orders to ongoing supply programs for large-scale developments, Barrier
Fencing Supply Company is committed to providing dependable service, consistent product
availability, and the expertise needed to support projects of every size.



Contact Barrier Fencing Supply Company today to request wholesale pricing, product information, or
assistance with your next project.

Barrier Fencing Supply Company is a leading wholesale fencing manufacturer and distributor serving
contractors, dealers, builders, and developers throughout North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia,
and the Southeast. With in-house vinyl fence manufacturing and extensive distribution capabilities,
we provide dependable access to premium fencing materials backed by consistent inventory,
competitive pricing, and responsive customer support.

entry systems, agricultural and equine fencing, custom stall systems, barn components, jump
standards, arenas, and a full range of fencing accessories. Whether you're supplying a residential
installation, commercial development, municipal project, or agricultural facility, we have the
products and capacity to keep your project moving.

professional installation. Our manufacturing capabilities allow us to maintain greater quality
control, improve lead times, and offer flexible solutions that meet the demands of today's
contractors and distributors.



From single truckload orders to ongoing supply programs for large-scale developments, Barrier
Fencing Supply Company is committed to providing dependable service, consistent product
availability, and the expertise needed to support projects of every size.

#### Setting The Standard In

### Architectural Metal Systems

Berridge Manufacturing Company provides all of your architectural metal products from one convenient
source. For over 50 years, Berridge has set the standard in designing, developing, and manufacturing
the highest quality architectural metal products and portable roll forming technology. Berridge
highly-skilled sales, engineering, and marketing departments are uniquely qualified to assist with
your projects. In addition, Berridge products are supported by industry-leading technical testing
and warranties.

## Panel Systems For Fascia, Walls And Soffits

Berridge Manufacturing understands that durability, aesthetic appeal and efficiency are critical
components of your property’s exterior. This knowledge is why we offer reliable panel systems for
various structural applications.

With 18 options to choose from, our panel systems serve as an excellent choice for those looking to
improve their walls, fascia and soffit systems. These panels are also suitable for screen walls and
Berridge Fencing Systems. Our options are available in various finishes, from a sleek and smooth
appearance to traditional wood-grain overlays.

With a range of colors and finishing options to choose from, you can expect excellent results when
you choose one of these durable systems for your next project.

## Premium Metal Standing Seam Roofing Options

Standing seam roofing is known for its durability and low-maintenance requirements. When you choose
Berridge to provide your next standing seam system, you can explore a range of options crafted to
fit the needs of your property.

Our systems offer versatility in terms of architectural design. We offer standing seam systems that
add texture to any structure, such as minimalistic straight designs and cutting-edge convex curved
applications. With application options from open-framed to solid sheathing, you can trust we have a
product that meets your structural demands.

## Metal Shingle Systems For Any Project

Your property’s exterior serves as a first impression to clients, friends and competitors. For those
seeking a roofing system that intermixes durability with aesthetics, look no further than the metal
shingle options from Berridge. We provide styles that suit a range of stylistic preferences, from
contemporary to traditional.

Depending on your needs, these shingle systems can be applied to roofing, fascia, walls and steep
mansards. These products are strong and stylish. They’re made from 24-gage steel designed for
coverage, protection and reliability.

Whether you desire transformative Victorian roof shingles, scalloped fish scale designs or the
timeless design of classical systems, we’re prepared to help you find a design that meets your
needs. Experience the Berridge difference and explore our shingle systems today.

## Over 30 Colors Of Simulated Tile Roofing

Are you seeking the aesthetic of tile for your property, but need a system that is durable and
reliable? Not to fret, Berridge Manufacturing offers simulated tile roofing that fulfills these
needs. Our S-Tile and Spanish Tile systems intermix strength with style, keeping your property
resilient and elegant for years to come.

Traditional roofing tiles are often made of terracotta. As one of the heaviest roofing materials on
the market, these systems can inflict stress on roofing systems and cause wear over time. Our
simulated tile systems provide the aesthetics of terracotta materials, without sacrificing your
property’s structural integrity.

Expect unparalleled performance and a range of color options when you choose one of these systems
for your project.

## Durable Fencing And Enclosure Systems

For those seeking privacy options for dumpsters or yard spaces, Berridge Manufacturing has two
dependable solutions. Our architectural privacy fences are an effective option for those who need
dividers for their property. These systems are recyclable and come in a range of height options,
suiting a range of fencing needs.

Our dumpster enclosures are equally as efficient. If you want to shield the unsightly appearance of
waste, we offer visually appealing enclosure spaces for dumpsters. These can be installed on asphalt
or concrete pads, integrating easily into various environments.

## Get In Touch With Berridge Manufacturing

For architectural products that stand the test of time, turn to Berridge Manufacturing. We’ve
provided quality systems since 1970, making us a trustworthy choice for your commercial needs.
Contact us today to explore your options.

#### Setting The Standard In

### Architectural Metal Systems

Berridge Manufacturing Company provides all of your architectural metal products from one convenient
source. For over 50 years, Berridge has set the standard in designing, developing, and manufacturing
the highest quality architectural metal products and portable roll forming technology. Berridge
highly-skilled sales, engineering, and marketing departments are uniquely qualified to assist with
your projects. In addition, Berridge products are supported by industry-leading technical testing
and warranties.

## Panel Systems For Fascia, Walls And Soffits

Berridge Manufacturing understands that durability, aesthetic appeal and efficiency are critical
components of your property’s exterior. This knowledge is why we offer reliable panel systems for
various structural applications.

With 18 options to choose from, our panel systems serve as an excellent choice for those looking to
improve their walls, fascia and soffit systems. These panels are also suitable for screen walls and
Berridge Fencing Systems. Our options are available in various finishes, from a sleek and smooth
appearance to traditional wood-grain overlays.

With a range of colors and finishing options to choose from, you can expect excellent results when
you choose one of these durable systems for your next project.

## Premium Metal Standing Seam Roofing Options

Standing seam roofing is known for its durability and low-maintenance requirements. When you choose
Berridge to provide your next standing seam system, you can explore a range of options crafted to
fit the needs of your property.

Our systems offer versatility in terms of architectural design. We offer standing seam systems that
add texture to any structure, such as minimalistic straight designs and cutting-edge convex curved
applications. With application options from open-framed to solid sheathing, you can trust we have a
product that meets your structural demands.

## Metal Shingle Systems For Any Project

Your property’s exterior serves as a first impression to clients, friends and competitors. For those
seeking a roofing system that intermixes durability with aesthetics, look no further than the metal
shingle options from Berridge. We provide styles that suit a range of stylistic preferences, from
contemporary to traditional.

Depending on your needs, these shingle systems can be applied to roofing, fascia, walls and steep
mansards. These products are strong and stylish. They’re made from 24-gage steel designed for
coverage, protection and reliability.

Whether you desire transformative Victorian roof shingles, scalloped fish scale designs or the
timeless design of classical systems, we’re prepared to help you find a design that meets your
needs. Experience the Berridge difference and explore our shingle systems today.

## Over 30 Colors Of Simulated Tile Roofing

Are you seeking the aesthetic of tile for your property, but need a system that is durable and
reliable? Not to fret, Berridge Manufacturing offers simulated tile roofing that fulfills these
needs. Our S-Tile and Spanish Tile systems intermix strength with style, keeping your property
resilient and elegant for years to come.

Traditional roofing tiles are often made of terracotta. As one of the heaviest roofing materials on
the market, these systems can inflict stress on roofing systems and cause wear over time. Our
simulated tile systems provide the aesthetics of terracotta materials, without sacrificing your
property’s structural integrity.

Expect unparalleled performance and a range of color options when you choose one of these systems
for your project.

## Durable Fencing And Enclosure Systems

For those seeking privacy options for dumpsters or yard spaces, Berridge Manufacturing has two
dependable solutions. Our architectural privacy fences are an effective option for those who need
dividers for their property. These systems are recyclable and come in a range of height options,
suiting a range of fencing needs.

Our dumpster enclosures are equally as efficient. If you want to shield the unsightly appearance of
waste, we offer visually appealing enclosure spaces for dumpsters. These can be installed on asphalt
or concrete pads, integrating easily into various environments.

## Get In Touch With Berridge Manufacturing

For architectural products that stand the test of time, turn to Berridge Manufacturing. We’ve
provided quality systems since 1970, making us a trustworthy choice for your commercial needs.
Contact us today to explore your options.

# Perimeter Protection Solutions for Residential, Commercial & Critical Infrastructure

Betafence develops perimeter protection solutions for residential, commercial, industrial and
critical infrastructure projects worldwide. The portfolio covers the complete site boundary with
perimeter fencing, welded mesh fencing, fence panels, posts, privacy systems, pedestrian and vehicle
gates, access control systems, high-security fencing, crash-rated gates, anti-ram protection,
bollards, road blockers, hostile vehicle mitigation and passive anti-drone systems. Solutions can be
selected according to appearance, operational use, required security level, regional availability
and applicable certification requirements.

## Residential solutions

Residential systems are developed around secure outdoor living, privacy, design and straightforward
installation. Matching components allow the fence line, access points and privacy elements to form
one coherent system around the property.
* [Architectural and professional post systems][118]
* [Rigid panel fencing systems][119]
* [Privacy slats, boards and infills][120]
* [Residential swing and sliding gates][121]
* Decorative fencing and gabion concepts
* Welded mesh and fencing rolls

## Commercial solutions

Commercial perimeter systems are designed for reliable daily performance around schools, warehouses,
logistics sites, business parks, public buildings and industrial facilities. The range combines
durable fence lines with compatible posts, gates and privacy options.
* [Professional 3D and twin-wire panel systems][122]
* Anti-climb commercial mesh fencing
* Post systems for different fixing methods and terrain
* Commercial swing and sliding gates
* Privacy solutions for compatible panel systems
* Decorative systems and fencing rolls

## Perimeter protection

Perimeter protection solutions address forced entry, climbing, cutting, vehicle intrusion and drone
threats. They are developed for sites where protection must be matched to operational risks, access
requirements and recognised security standards.
* [Certified high-security fencing systems][123]
* [High-security swing, sliding and speed gates][124]
* [Crash-rated fencing and integrated HVM systems][125]
* Static, retractable and shallow-foundation bollards
* Crash-rated road wedges and road blockers
* [Passive low-level and lateral anti-drone protection][126]

## One perimeter, multiple layers of protection

A complete perimeter is more than a fence. The required solution can combine boundary definition,
anti-climb and anti-cut performance, controlled pedestrian or vehicle access, hostile vehicle
mitigation and protection against unmanned aerial threats. Betafence systems are therefore organised
around the way a site is used and the threats it must resist.

High-security welded mesh, anti-climb panels, reinforced fencing and certified delay systems are

## No One Knows Fencing Like We Do

Highly recommend this company!! From the first call to get an estimate to the Estimator Levi Davis
that came out and answered all my questions with patience, to the installation a few weeks later by
an amazing crew, Justin Campbell ,Drea and Scott. They worked so hard in this Florida heat and the
end result was an impeccable fence and gate install. I am a perfectionist, and I was rendered
speachless. They rocked it! Thank you Big Sun.

### Gee Singh-Newbanks

We love our new fence. Rod Tomak was the best installer we could have asked for. 300+ feet was a lot
and it came out perfect. Just as we wanted it. Everyone we were in contact with was very
professional and eager to give us the best product and service. Thank you Pamela and Katie and
everyone else in the office. A+++ Thanks again Tom for your professionalism and expertise.

### Billy Hitt

I’m so impressed with the job Big Sun Fencing completed. The quality of the materials and the
craftsmanship are top-notch. The installers was professional, courteous, and got the job done on
time. Highly recommend!”

The fence looks great and the team was a pleasure to work with. Five stars and highly recommended!

### Patrick Abner

I am so pleased with my fence.
They came out right away and gave me a quote that was very fair. Installed it in a timely manner.
The installation was fun and exciting Rod was super nice guy when above and beyond just putting a
fence up The people in the office were very friendly and treated me like a valued customer very
happy with the whole process.

### Jenny Lydon

Big Sun did excellent work installing my new fencing. Everyone was very professional and efficient
and obviously knew what they were doing. Excellent customer service, kept me in the loop the whole
time. I always knew what was happening and when. Cleaned up after themselves and left my property
better than they found it. I would definitely use them again on any future projects.

### Mike Knight

Big Sun Fencing did an amazing job on my new aluminum fence. They were easy to work with to schedule
an install date. They arrived on time and completed the job as requested. My dogs are super happy to
have a fenced in yard to run around free in. Definitely recommend Big Sun Fencing.

## Who We Are

### About
### Our Company

Established in 1965 by Mr. Lee R. Smith, Capitol Wholesale Fence Company, Inc. is a full-line,
wholesale fence distributor. You can count on Capitol Wholesale Fence for all of your fencing needs.
Our goal is still to provide the best customer experience in the fence industry with our
knowledgeable staff and high-quality products.

In 2021, Capitol Wholesale become an integral part of Fencing Supply Group (FSG). FSG serves
professional fencing contractors who provide new, improvement, and repair fencing services across
residential, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure end markets. Joining FSG allows Capitol
Wholesale to better serve its customers and provide the exceptional customer service our customers
are accustomed to.

## Who We Are

### About
### Our Company

Established in 1965 by Mr. Lee R. Smith, Capitol Wholesale Fence Company, Inc. is a full-line,
wholesale fence distributor. You can count on Capitol Wholesale Fence for all of your fencing needs.
Our goal is still to provide the best customer experience in the fence industry with our
knowledgeable staff and high-quality products.

In 2021, Capitol Wholesale become an integral part of Fencing Supply Group (FSG). FSG serves
professional fencing contractors who provide new, improvement, and repair fencing services across
residential, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure end markets. Joining FSG allows Capitol
Wholesale to better serve its customers and provide the exceptional customer service our customers
are accustomed to.

Since 1917, Century Fence has been transforming challenges into growth, pioneering opportunities to
help build safer communities with fencing.

‍

Founded and sustained on the entrepreneurial vision and adaptability of Henry Bryant, Century Fence
continues to build on the values of working together, being humble, and being hungry — providing

### Commercial Vinyl Fencing for Strong, Stylish Boundaries

High-quality vinyl fencing solutions designed for durability, low maintenance, and timeless style.

### Ornamental Fencing

Designed for strength and style, our ornamental fences provide a timeless look with modern
durability.

### High Security Fencing & Commercial Security Fencing Solutions

For critical infrastructure, commercial facilities, and high-risk areas, our security fences provide
unmatched strength, safety, and perimeter control.

### Chain Link Commercial Fence & Security Solutions

Our quality chain link fences provide reliable security, durability, and affordability for a wide
range of commercial applications.

### Commercial Fences and Gates for Secure Access

Our expert commercial gate team installs slide gates, swing gates, turnstiles, lift gates,
operators, or custom gate designs.

### Decorative Security Fence Designs for Safe, Stylish Spaces

privacy, and clearly defined boundaries.

that aligns with your project's objectives and timeline.

Century Fence provides expert repairs for any commercial fencing, restoring your fence to its
original condition while securing your site.

## frequently asked questions.

Everything you need to know about our fencing products and solution services.

1. Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

We are a direct manufacturer specializing in metal fencing, with our own factory and complete set of
production equipment. From product research and development, design, and manufacturing, to surface
treatment, transportation, and installation, we handle the entire process in-house.

2. What types of metal fencing products do you offer?

We specialize in high-end metal perimeter security products, including:

Wire Mesh Fencing (such as 358 fencing, BRC fencing, chain link fencing, 3D/2D fencing, etc.,
commonly used in industrial parks, ports, airports, and other areas requiring separation or
security).

Steel Tube Fencing/Railings/Guardrails (suitable for roads, municipal, and industrial applications).

Entrance Gates (Trackless Cantilever/Tracked sliding gates, heavy-duty anti-collision gates,
single/double-swing gates, turnstile gates, etc.)

3. Can your fencing products be customized?

Of course! We have a professional R&D team and designers who can provide customized design services
based on your needs, such as:

Installation methods adapted to different terrains”.

Color, size, and structural adjustments

Enhanced anti-corrosion, anti-climbing, and anti-impact features

4. How is the quality of your products?

Our products undergo rigorous quality control at every stage, from material selection to production,
surface treatment, packaging, and transportation. For example, we use advanced hot-dip galvanizing
combined with electrostatic powder coating, offering exceptional corrosion resistance and a service
life of over 10 years—far surpassing that of standard fences. We have successful cases in multiple
countries worldwide, ensuring reliable quality.

5. What scenarios are your products suitable for?

Our products are widely used in various high-security applications, including industrial parks,
ports, borders, highways, municipal buildings, prisons, military facilities, and airports. Whether
the need is for anti-corrosion, anti-climbing, and impact resistance, or for aesthetics, durability,
and ease of installation, we can meet all requirements.

6. What is your production capacity like?

Our 3 factories covers a total area of 118,000 square meters and is equipped with its own
galvanizing workshop, coating workshop, and welding facilities, ensuring we have the capacity to
handle your orders without any concerns.

7. Can you handle large orders?

With advanced production equipment, a well-established supply chain system, and sufficient annual
production capacity, we are fully capable of handling large-volume orders. Whether it’s a small
batch trial order or long-term, stable supply, we can meet your needs.

8. Can you provide samples of your fencing products?

Yes, we can provide samples. The sample cost and shipping fees can be discussed based on the product
type and destination. Once confirmed, we will arrange for shipment.

manufacturing and distribution business, a transition made easier by the considerable investment
made in new plant and machinery. Now, with an impressive inventory list that includes pre-cast
concrete equipment, two Panelmaster machines and a fleet of delivery vehicles fitted with Moffett
forklift trucks, the name EFC has become synonymous with quality and competitiveness, a family
business that delivers a comprehensive range of quality Fencing and Landscaping products to a
growing number of satisfied customer throughout the UK.

### EFC FENCING - ESTABLISHED IN 1959

**Our commitment to service, quality and value for money has earned us the enviable reputation of
being a major supplier to both Trade and Retail customers.**

EFC Fencing has made a gradual transition from being a contracting firm to what is now a major
manufacturing and distribution business, a transition made easier by the considerable investment
made in new plant and machinery. Now, with an impressive inventory list that includes pre-cast
concrete equipment, two Panelmaster machines and a fleet of delivery vehicles fitted with Moffett
forklift trucks, the name EFC has become synonymous with quality and competitiveness, a family
business that delivers a comprehensive range of quality Fencing and Landscaping products to a
growing number of satisfied customer throughout the UK.

**If you have any questions or can’t find what you’re looking for, please don’t hesitate to give us
a call on [01785 284477][219] or email us on [sales@efcfencing.com][220]. Thank you!**

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does fence installation cost per foot?

Based on our last 12 months, most homeowners pay about **$22–$56 per ft** for wood and **$36–$68 per
ft** for vinyl. Privacy fences fall in these ranges (they're typically solid wood or vinyl). Final
price depends on height, gates, terrain, removal/haul-away, and permits.
* **Wood**: budget-friendly upfront; more upkeep over time.
* **Vinyl**: higher upfront; very low maintenance, consistent look.
* **Add-ons**: gates, post caps, staining/sealing, old fence removal.

Site factors: slopes, trees/rocks, utility locates can increase labor. Prices vary by city and
season; we confirm exact costs after a quick site measure.

**Source**: Ergeon internal data, last 12 months; Wood (41,420 projects), Vinyl (15,556). Ranges
reflect materials + labor and vary by city and season.

### What's the lowest-maintenance fence material?

The lowest-maintenance options are vinyl and powder-coated aluminum. Vinyl privacy panels need only
an occasional rinse. Aluminum picket won't rust and usually just needs a quick wash. Powder-coated
steel is durable but should be checked for scratches/chips (touch up to prevent rust). Chain link
(galvanized or vinyl-coated) is also low-maintenance, but offers little privacy.
* **Vinyl** (privacy): No painting or staining; wash with hose/soapy water as needed. Good fade
  resistance.
* **Aluminum** (open view/pool): Powder coat resists corrosion—even in wet climates. Minimal
  cleaning.
* **Steel** (ornamental): Tough and elegant; powder coat protects well. Inspect yearly for
  chips—touch up to stop rust, especially near sprinklers, de-icing salt, or coastal air.
* **Chain link** (economical): Galvanized or black vinyl-coated is virtually maintenance-free—just
  rinse. Minimal privacy unless you add slats/screens.
* **Wood** (for comparison): Highest upkeep—periodic sealing/painting and occasional board repairs.

### Which fence lasts the longest with the least upkeep?

For the least upkeep and long life, vinyl (privacy) and powder-coated aluminum (open style) lead the
pack. Powder-coated steel is very durable but needs occasional touch-ups if the coating chips. Chain
link also lasts a long time with little care but offers minimal privacy. Wood can last decades, but
only with periodic sealing/painting and small repairs.
* **Wood** (most requested look): Classic and repairable. To reach long lifespans, plan on
  sealing/staining every 2–3 years, replacing the odd board, and keeping soil/irrigation off the
  pickets. With upkeep, **15–25+ years** is common.
* **Vinyl** (lowest maintenance privacy): No painting or staining; rinse with hose/soapy water.
  Built-in color resists fading. Allow for thermal expansion in hot/cold climates. Typical life
  **20–30+ years** with minimal care.
* **Aluminum** (open look / pool-friendly): Powder coat resists corrosion; usually needs only a
  rinse. Often **25–30+ years** in residential settings.
* **Steel** (ornamental): Strong and elegant. Powder coat protects well—inspect annually for chips
  and touch up to prevent rust, especially near sprinklers/salt. **20–25+ years** with care.
* **Chain link** (budget/utility): Galvanized or vinyl-coated frames last **20–30 years** with very
  little maintenance; add slats/screens if privacy is needed.

### What's the best fence for security?

For most homes, a **6-ft** (or local max) privacy fence with a self-closing, self-latching, lockable
gate is the best all-around security choice. For visible deterrence, spear-top aluminum/steel with
tight picket spacing works well. Chain link is durable but offers little privacy unless upgraded.
* **Vinyl privacy** (lowest upkeep): Solid panels block sightlines and lack toe-holds. Set posts in
  concrete to frost depth and add a kickboard/continuous bottom rail to prevent lift-under.
* **Wood privacy**: Choose board-on-board or solid with the smooth face inside (no exposed rails to
  climb). Use beefier posts where loads are higher.
* **Aluminum/steel** (ornamental security): Go 6 ft spear-top with ≤ 3 in picket spacing. It's hard
  to scale and looks premium; steel may need touch-up if the coating chips.
* **Chain link** (utility): Use smaller mesh and a bottom tension wire/rail to prevent push-out.
  Slats reduce visibility but can add footholds; check local rules.
* **Height & toppers**: Many places allow a decorative topper (e.g., lattice/arched cap) that can
  bring total height to **7–8 ft**. Always check your municipality's planning/zoning
  department—heights over 6 ft often require a permit and may have setback/corner-visibility limits.
* **Gates & hardware** (critical): Self-closing hinges, self-latching/lockable latch, through-bolted
  hardware, drop rod on double gates; keep the under-gate gap minimal.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does fence installation cost per foot?

Based on our last 12 months, most homeowners pay about **$22–$56 per ft** for wood and **$36–$68 per
ft** for vinyl. Privacy fences fall in these ranges (they're typically solid wood or vinyl). Final
price depends on height, gates, terrain, removal/haul-away, and permits.
* **Wood**: budget-friendly upfront; more upkeep over time.
* **Vinyl**: higher upfront; very low maintenance, consistent look.
* **Add-ons**: gates, post caps, staining/sealing, old fence removal.

Site factors: slopes, trees/rocks, utility locates can increase labor. Prices vary by city and
season; we confirm exact costs after a quick site measure.

**Source**: Ergeon internal data, last 12 months; Wood (41,420 projects), Vinyl (15,556). Ranges
reflect materials + labor and vary by city and season.

### What's the lowest-maintenance fence material?

The lowest-maintenance options are vinyl and powder-coated aluminum. Vinyl privacy panels need only
an occasional rinse. Aluminum picket won't rust and usually just needs a quick wash. Powder-coated
steel is durable but should be checked for scratches/chips (touch up to prevent rust). Chain link
(galvanized or vinyl-coated) is also low-maintenance, but offers little privacy.
* **Vinyl** (privacy): No painting or staining; wash with hose/soapy water as needed. Good fade
  resistance.
* **Aluminum** (open view/pool): Powder coat resists corrosion—even in wet climates. Minimal
  cleaning.
* **Steel** (ornamental): Tough and elegant; powder coat protects well. Inspect yearly for
  chips—touch up to stop rust, especially near sprinklers, de-icing salt, or coastal air.
* **Chain link** (economical): Galvanized or black vinyl-coated is virtually maintenance-free—just
  rinse. Minimal privacy unless you add slats/screens.
* **Wood** (for comparison): Highest upkeep—periodic sealing/painting and occasional board repairs.

### Which fence lasts the longest with the least upkeep?

For the least upkeep and long life, vinyl (privacy) and powder-coated aluminum (open style) lead the
pack. Powder-coated steel is very durable but needs occasional touch-ups if the coating chips. Chain
link also lasts a long time with little care but offers minimal privacy. Wood can last decades, but
only with periodic sealing/painting and small repairs.
* **Wood** (most requested look): Classic and repairable. To reach long lifespans, plan on
  sealing/staining every 2–3 years, replacing the odd board, and keeping soil/irrigation off the
  pickets. With upkeep, **15–25+ years** is common.
* **Vinyl** (lowest maintenance privacy): No painting or staining; rinse with hose/soapy water.
  Built-in color resists fading. Allow for thermal expansion in hot/cold climates. Typical life
  **20–30+ years** with minimal care.
* **Aluminum** (open look / pool-friendly): Powder coat resists corrosion; usually needs only a
  rinse. Often **25–30+ years** in residential settings.
* **Steel** (ornamental): Strong and elegant. Powder coat protects well—inspect annually for chips
  and touch up to prevent rust, especially near sprinklers/salt. **20–25+ years** with care.
* **Chain link** (budget/utility): Galvanized or vinyl-coated frames last **20–30 years** with very
  little maintenance; add slats/screens if privacy is needed.

### What's the best fence for security?

For most homes, a **6-ft** (or local max) privacy fence with a self-closing, self-latching, lockable
gate is the best all-around security choice. For visible deterrence, spear-top aluminum/steel with
tight picket spacing works well. Chain link is durable but offers little privacy unless upgraded.
* **Vinyl privacy** (lowest upkeep): Solid panels block sightlines and lack toe-holds. Set posts in
  concrete to frost depth and add a kickboard/continuous bottom rail to prevent lift-under.
* **Wood privacy**: Choose board-on-board or solid with the smooth face inside (no exposed rails to
  climb). Use beefier posts where loads are higher.
* **Aluminum/steel** (ornamental security): Go 6 ft spear-top with ≤ 3 in picket spacing. It's hard
  to scale and looks premium; steel may need touch-up if the coating chips.
* **Chain link** (utility): Use smaller mesh and a bottom tension wire/rail to prevent push-out.
  Slats reduce visibility but can add footholds; check local rules.
* **Height & toppers**: Many places allow a decorative topper (e.g., lattice/arched cap) that can
  bring total height to **7–8 ft**. Always check your municipality's planning/zoning
  department—heights over 6 ft often require a permit and may have setback/corner-visibility limits.
* **Gates & hardware** (critical): Self-closing hinges, self-latching/lockable latch, through-bolted
  hardware, drop rod on double gates; keep the under-gate gap minimal.

### How long does a typical fence installation take?

In clear site conditions (no dense vegetation, steep slopes, tight access, or rocky soil), our crews
install about **60 linear feet per day**. That means a 100-ft run is **~1–2 install days** and
200-ft is **~3–4 days**. Posts are set in concrete and framing can usually begin the same day.
Complex sites, extra gates, or pool code can add time. Concrete cures in **~30 days**.
* **Rule of thumb**: ~60 LF/day in uncomplicated conditions.
* **Access**: Please keep 2 ft of clearance along at least one side; unmoved obstacles can trigger

We offer comprehensive fencing solutions for both residential and commercial properties, designed to
meet Alaska’s unique weather and terrain challenges. Our services are flexible, reliable, and
crafted with quality in mind.

[Fence Installation]

### Fence Installation

Expert installation of durable fences for homes and businesses, built to withstand Alaska’s
conditions.

Timely and professional repairs to keep your fence safe, strong, and functional.

### Fence Maintenance

Regular upkeep and seasonal care prolong the life and performance of your fence.

Professional excavating and landscaping services to prepare your property for fencing or other
improvements.

Custom welding solutions for fences, gates, and other metal structures.

[65]

Personalized estimates and service with clear, honest communication. Reach out by phone or email
anytime.

Fence Alaska is a local, family-owned company run by lifelong Alaskans. Our team combines hands-on
experience with deep knowledge of Alaska’s unique conditions to deliver fences that last.

* Expertise in installations, repairs, and maintenance
* In-depth knowledge of Alaska’s weather, soil, and permitting

## FENCE ALASKA Residential & Commercial
## Fencing Across Alaska

Life long Alaskan family owned

[ Free Estimate ][29]
[Hero Image]

## Fencing Services

We offer comprehensive fencing solutions for both residential and commercial properties, designed to
meet Alaska’s unique weather and terrain challenges. Our services are flexible, reliable, and
crafted with quality in mind.

[Fence Installation]

### Fence Installation

Expert installation of durable fences for homes and businesses, built to withstand Alaska’s
conditions.

[Fence Repair]

### Fence Repair

Timely and professional repairs to keep your fence safe, strong, and functional.

[Fence Maintenance]

### Fence Maintenance

Regular upkeep and seasonal care prolong the life and performance of your fence.

[Excavating & Landscaping]

### Excavating & Landscaping

Professional excavating and landscaping services to prepare your property for fencing or other
improvements.

[Welding]

### Welding

Custom welding solutions for fences, gates, and other metal structures.

Each service is tailored to provide reliability, quality, and peace of mind for every property type.

[ View Our Fencing Services ][30]

## Our Key Advantages

[65]

Experienced professionals delivering reliable fence repairs and installations across Alaska.

[Group 11]

Deep local knowledge ensures durability despite Alaska’s challenging weather conditions.

[66]

Personalized estimates and service with clear, honest communication. Reach out by phone or email
anytime.

[ Learn About Our Story ][31]

## Why Fence Alaska

Fence Alaska is a local, family-owned company run by lifelong Alaskans. Our team combines hands-on
experience with deep knowledge of Alaska’s unique conditions to deliver fences that last.
* Local, family-owned with lifelong Alaskan roots
* Expertise in installations, repairs, and maintenance
* In-depth knowledge of Alaska’s weather, soil, and permitting

## Our Service Areas

Based in Wasilla, Fence Alaska proudly serves customers from Talkeetna to Seward—and sometimes
beyond. Our team brings reliable, professional fencing services to both residential and commercial
properties across the region.
* Wasilla, AK 99654
* Anchorage, AK
* Talkeetna, AK
* Seward and surrounding areas

[Group 10 (1)]
[68 (2)]

## Start Your Project

From residential yards to commercial properties, our work speaks for itself. Contact us for a free
estimate.

## Straight pricing, published up front

Most fence rental companies in the Phoenix metro make you call for pricing. We publish ours, because
if you’re a GC bidding a job on Price Road at 9 p.m., you need numbers now.

─────────────────────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────
Rental type                                  │Typical Chandler price    
─────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────
Chain link fence (per linear foot)           │$1.50 – $3.00 / ft / month
─────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────
Freestanding panels (per panel)              │$20 – $50 / panel / month 
─────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────
Typical residential job (pool build, remodel)│$150 – $500 / month       
─────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────
Construction site perimeter                  │$800 – $3,000 / month     
─────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────
Delivery, install & removal                  │$100 – $500 flat          
─────────────────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────

Longer terms bring the monthly rate down. Short-term event work is quoted as a flat package. And for
anyone weighing rental against buying a stack of panels outright: renting is the affordable route
for a one-project need, because the monthly rate carries the install labor, ballast, and pickup that
ownership dumps on you. The full breakdown — including windscreen add-ons, gates, and barricades —
is on our [pricing page][28].

## Why GCs, event organizers, and pool builders call us

**Commercial contractors** get a fence line that passes inspection the first time. We know Maricopa
County’s **Rule 310 dust control** requirements and how a fenced, screened perimeter fits into a
dust control plan. We know that a site trailer, a laydown yard, and a staging area each need
different gate placement. And we track our install dates so your fence is off the site — and off
your invoice — when the job closes out.

**Event organizers** get equipment that handles Arizona event season, which runs roughly October
through April here. Downtown Chandler’s festival calendar, school carnivals, charity 5Ks on the
Paseo Trail, corporate events at the Airpark hangars — we scope the footage, deliver on your load-in
day, and pull it before your permit window closes. The Ostrich Festival’s move to Rawhide in 2026 is
a good reminder that Valley event venues change; your fencing vendor should be able to adapt layouts
on short notice.

**Pool builders** get code-compliant temporary barriers without babysitting the vendor. Arizona’s
pool barrier statute (**ARS 36-1681**) requires a 5-foot barrier around any pool holding 18 inches
of water — and in practice, Chandler inspectors want that barrier up from the moment the shell holds
water until the permanent perimeter fence passes final. We install at dig or shotcrete, maintain
through the build, and pull the fence the day you call it done. One PO, no gaps in coverage.

## The Chandler fence calendar: what season you’re renting into

Temporary fencing in the Valley is seasonal in ways out-of-state project managers consistently
underestimate, so here’s the local calendar in one place.

**October through April** is event season and prime construction weather. Fence and barricade
inventory across the metro tightens around the big festival weekends — March especially, when the
Ostrich Festival, spring training traffic, and every charity 5K in the southeast Valley land in the
same six weekends. If your event needs 400 feet of panels in March, book in January.

**May and June** are the dry furnace months: excellent for pours and framing, brutal on crews, quiet
on events. Delivery scheduling is easiest now, and it’s the right window to get summer-long fence
lines installed and properly ballasted *before* the storms.

**Mid-June through September** is monsoon season. Outflow winds are the main event from a fencing
standpoint — this is when under-ballasted, over-screened fence lines fail. Our installs carry
monsoon spec by default in these months: sandbags on every base, bracing on long runs, and honest
advice about how much windscreen your exposure can carry. Pool contractors should also note that a
monsoon storm can put code-triggering water into an open dig overnight, which is why we fence pool
sites at excavation rather than at fill.

**September and October** bring the changeover: monsoon tapers, event load-ins begin, and
construction schedules compress to hit year-end. It’s our busiest overlap; the earlier we see your
site plan, the better your install date.

## Panels or driven posts? The sixty-second answer

The most common question we get from first-time renters. **Freestanding panels** (12-ft sections on
weighted bases) install on any surface — asphalt, pavers, turf, decomposed granite — leave zero
holes, and reconfigure by hand mid-project. **Driven-post chain link** costs less per foot on long
runs and takes wind better, but requires soil you’re allowed to penetrate and a crew visit to
change. The rule of thumb: under three months or on any finished surface, panels; over six months on
open dirt, posts; in between, we’ll walk the site with you. Chandler’s built-out lots and paved
commercial corridors mean panels win here more often than in newer cities — one more reason a fence
vendor should actually know the market it serves.

## Serving the southeast Valley from Chandler

Our service area runs from the Loop 101/202 interchange south past Hunt Highway, and west across the
I-10 into Ahwatukee:
* **[Ocotillo][29]** — south Chandler’s lake-and-golf community, plus the Price Corridor employment
  core next door
* **[Sun Lakes][30]** — the 55+ community south of Chandler, where remodel and re-landscaping work
  never stops
* **[Ahwatukee][31]** — Phoenix’s foothills village across the I-10, fifteen minutes from our routes
* **[Maricopa][32]** — Pinal County’s fastest-growing city, down SR-347, where homebuilders are
  still opening new phases

Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Queen Creek, and Casa Grande jobs are quoted case by case — usually the answer
is yes.

## What “same-week” actually means

When you request a quote, here’s the sequence: we confirm footage and layout (a site plan, a Google
Maps screenshot with a line drawn on it, or a five-minute call all work), we quote the full cost
including delivery and removal, and we schedule install. For standard chain link panel jobs inside
our core Chandler service area, that whole cycle typically fits inside one week — often faster for
small jobs. Complex sites with windscreen, multiple gates, or right-of-way encroachment take a
little longer because we’d rather flag a permit problem before install than after.

No phone tag. No “a rep will contact you.” Send the request, get the number, get the fence.

Two details that separate a clean rental from a headache, and how we handle both: **extensions** —
construction schedules slip, so month-to-month extensions continue at your original rate, never a
renegotiated “extension price”; and **removal** — the pickup date is written into the quote, and
