Need temporary fencing in Chandler? We deliver and install chain link panels, construction site
fencing, event barricades, and pool-code barriers across Chandler and the southeast Valley —
typically within the week, at transparent rates of **$1.50–$3.00 per linear foot per month**.
Request a quote and you’ll get a real number, not a callback runaround.

Chandler Fence Rental is locally operated and built around the three jobs this city actually
generates: **commercial construction** along the Price Road Corridor and Chandler Airpark,
**events** from downtown street festivals to the Ostrich Festival crowds every March, and **pool
construction barriers** for one of the most pool-dense housing markets in Arizona.

## Temporary fencing built for how Chandler actually builds

Chandler isn’t a generic Phoenix suburb. It’s the semiconductor capital of the Southwest, and that
shapes the fencing work here.

Intel’s Ocotillo campus — now five fabs deep after Fab 52 came online — anchors the south end of the
**Price Road Corridor**, and the ripple effect is constant: contractor laydown yards, utility
trenching, road widening, and tenant improvement projects up and down Price Road from Chandler
Boulevard to Loop 202. NXP wrapped a $100 million expansion of its Chandler campus in early 2026.
Every one of those projects needs perimeter fence, and most need it fast.

Meanwhile the **Chandler Airpark area** around Chandler Municipal Airport keeps filling in with flex
industrial, hangars, and commercial pads along Germann and Queen Creek Roads. And because Chandler’s
residential land is nearly built out, the work inside neighborhoods skews toward remodels, pool
builds, and teardown-rebuilds — jobs where a clean temporary fence line matters because the
neighbors are twenty feet away.

We stock the equipment for all of it:
* **[Construction site fencing][22]** — full-perimeter chain link for commercial and residential job
  sites, with windscreen and gate options
* **[Chain link fence panels][23]** — freestanding 12-ft panels with sandbag-weighted bases, any
  length, any layout
* **[Event fencing][24]** — perimeters and crowd control for festivals, races, and private events
* **[Barricade rental][25]** — steel pedestrian barricades, delivered and picked up on your schedule
* **[Temporary pool fencing][26]** — ARS 36-1681-compliant barriers for the entire pool construction
  window
* **[Privacy screen and windscreen][27]** — mesh screening added to any fence line for privacy, dust
  control, or branding

## Straight pricing, published up front

Most fence rental companies in the Phoenix metro make you call for pricing. We publish ours, because
if you’re a GC bidding a job on Price Road at 9 p.m., you need numbers now.

Longer terms bring the monthly rate down. Short-term event work is quoted as a flat package. And for
anyone weighing rental against buying a stack of panels outright: renting is the affordable route
for a one-project need, because the monthly rate carries the install labor, ballast, and pickup that
ownership dumps on you. The full breakdown — including windscreen add-ons, gates, and barricades —
is on our [pricing page][28].

## Why GCs, event organizers, and pool builders call us

**Commercial contractors** get a fence line that passes inspection the first time. We know Maricopa
County’s **Rule 310 dust control** requirements and how a fenced, screened perimeter fits into a
dust control plan. We know that a site trailer, a laydown yard, and a staging area each need
different gate placement. And we track our install dates so your fence is off the site — and off
your invoice — when the job closes out.

**Event organizers** get equipment that handles Arizona event season, which runs roughly October
through April here. Downtown Chandler’s festival calendar, school carnivals, charity 5Ks on the
Paseo Trail, corporate events at the Airpark hangars — we scope the footage, deliver on your load-in
day, and pull it before your permit window closes. The Ostrich Festival’s move to Rawhide in 2026 is
a good reminder that Valley event venues change; your fencing vendor should be able to adapt layouts
on short notice.

**Pool builders** get code-compliant temporary barriers without babysitting the vendor. Arizona’s
pool barrier statute (**ARS 36-1681**) requires a 5-foot barrier around any pool holding 18 inches
of water — and in practice, Chandler inspectors want that barrier up from the moment the shell holds
water until the permanent perimeter fence passes final. We install at dig or shotcrete, maintain
through the build, and pull the fence the day you call it done. One PO, no gaps in coverage.

## The Chandler fence calendar: what season you’re renting into

Temporary fencing in the Valley is seasonal in ways out-of-state project managers consistently
underestimate, so here’s the local calendar in one place.

**October through April** is event season and prime construction weather. Fence and barricade
inventory across the metro tightens around the big festival weekends — March especially, when the
Ostrich Festival, spring training traffic, and every charity 5K in the southeast Valley land in the
same six weekends. If your event needs 400 feet of panels in March, book in January.

**May and June** are the dry furnace months: excellent for pours and framing, brutal on crews, quiet
on events. Delivery scheduling is easiest now, and it’s the right window to get summer-long fence
lines installed and properly ballasted *before* the storms.

**Mid-June through September** is monsoon season. Outflow winds are the main event from a fencing
standpoint — this is when under-ballasted, over-screened fence lines fail. Our installs carry
monsoon spec by default in these months: sandbags on every base, bracing on long runs, and honest
advice about how much windscreen your exposure can carry. Pool contractors should also note that a
monsoon storm can put code-triggering water into an open dig overnight, which is why we fence pool
sites at excavation rather than at fill.

**September and October** bring the changeover: monsoon tapers, event load-ins begin, and
construction schedules compress to hit year-end. It’s our busiest overlap; the earlier we see your
site plan, the better your install date.

## Panels or driven posts? The sixty-second answer

The most common question we get from first-time renters. **Freestanding panels** (12-ft sections on
weighted bases) install on any surface — asphalt, pavers, turf, decomposed granite — leave zero
holes, and reconfigure by hand mid-project. **Driven-post chain link** costs less per foot on long
runs and takes wind better, but requires soil you’re allowed to penetrate and a crew visit to
change. The rule of thumb: under three months or on any finished surface, panels; over six months on
open dirt, posts; in between, we’ll walk the site with you. Chandler’s built-out lots and paved
commercial corridors mean panels win here more often than in newer cities — one more reason a fence
vendor should actually know the market it serves.

## Serving the southeast Valley from Chandler

Our service area runs from the Loop 101/202 interchange south past Hunt Highway, and west across the
I-10 into Ahwatukee:

* **[Sun Lakes][30]** — the 55+ community south of Chandler, where remodel and re-landscaping work
  never stops
* **[Ahwatukee][31]** — Phoenix’s foothills village across the I-10, fifteen minutes from our routes
* **[Maricopa][32]** — Pinal County’s fastest-growing city, down SR-347, where homebuilders are
  still opening new phases

Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Queen Creek, and Casa Grande jobs are quoted case by case — usually the answer
is yes.

## What “same-week” actually means

When you request a quote, here’s the sequence: we confirm footage and layout (a site plan, a Google
Maps screenshot with a line drawn on it, or a five-minute call all work), we quote the full cost
including delivery and removal, and we schedule install. For standard chain link panel jobs inside
our core Chandler service area, that whole cycle typically fits inside one week — often faster for
small jobs. Complex sites with windscreen, multiple gates, or right-of-way encroachment take a
little longer because we’d rather flag a permit problem before install than after.

No phone tag. No “a rep will contact you.” Send the request, get the number, get the fence.

# UK's Leading Metal & Handrailing Supplier | F.H. Brundle

Welcome to F.H.Brundle, a leading UK [steel supplier][339] and metal products specialist serving
trade professionals and contractors nationwide; from metal fabricators to commercial landscapers.
With over 11,000 products in stock across our nationwide [branches][340], we're your trusted partner
for comprehensive handrail systems, steel sections, fencing solutions, and far more beyond.

Comprehensive Handrailing & Balustrade Systems
* **Glass Balustrade Solutions:** Our [ frameless glass balustrade ][341] and glass balustrade
  systems combine modern aesthetics with robust engineering. Featuring the Pro-Railing range of
  stainless-steel handrailing and Fortitude Powder Coated Steel solutions. Our systems meet all UK
  Building Regulations.
* **Pro-Railing Modular Systems:** With over 1,000 components available, our [ Pro-Railing ][342]
  handrail systems enable quick installation of complex, safe and attractive balustrades.

  components, roof edge guardrails, self-closing gates, and [ Mezzanine handrailing ][344].

* **Gates & Access Control:** Gate frames, hardware, sliding gates, bi-folding gates, cantilever

# UK's Leading Metal & Handrailing Supplier | F.H. Brundle

Welcome to F.H.Brundle, a leading UK [steel supplier][339] and metal products specialist serving
trade professionals and contractors nationwide; from metal fabricators to commercial landscapers.
With over 11,000 products in stock across our nationwide [branches][340], we're your trusted partner
for comprehensive handrail systems, steel sections, fencing solutions, and far more beyond.

Comprehensive Handrailing & Balustrade Systems
* **Glass Balustrade Solutions:** Our [ frameless glass balustrade ][341] and glass balustrade
  systems combine modern aesthetics with robust engineering. Featuring the Pro-Railing range of
  stainless-steel handrailing and Fortitude Powder Coated Steel solutions. Our systems meet all UK
  Building Regulations.
* **Pro-Railing Modular Systems:** With over 1,000 components available, our [ Pro-Railing ][342]
  handrail systems enable quick installation of complex, safe and attractive balustrades.
* **Specialist Handrailing Products:** We stock DDA compliant handrails, [Tube Clamp][343]
  components, roof edge guardrails, self-closing gates, and [ Mezzanine handrailing ][344].

* **Other metals:** Aluminium, stainless steel, galvanised steel, and GRP profiles

* **Gates & Access Control:** Gate frames, hardware, sliding gates, bi-folding gates, cantilever

# Garrison Fencing

## Stylish aluminium railing, balustrade & fencing

**Marano® is the stylish and premium range of aluminium solutions from F.H.Brundle. Marano’s
extensive range primarily consists of aluminium railings, fencing and balustrade systems designed to
integrate perfectly into high-end outside spaces. **

Crafted and engineered from quality aluminium, Marano fence boards and the **Marano Integrated**
fencing system offer affordable, durable luxury for external perimeters. This range offers aesthetic
solutions for outdoor living that compliments elegant, modern design and provides practicality,
durability and sustainability.

The Marano railings range, consisting of **Marano Simplicity **and **Marano Blade**, introduces two
systems capable of seamlessly working in most residential settings – premium aluminium powder coated
in a black matte finish for timeless elegance. Whilst Simplicity offers affordable, simple style for
gardens, patios and pools, Blade is a railing solution that provides differing levels of privacy
alongside contemporary design.

Truly versatile handrail/balustrade systems are hard to come by, but **Marano Curve** and **Marano
Edge** are a rare and practical find. Combining the qualities of anodised aluminium and the strength
of tempered glass, both post-and-glass balustrade systems can be utilised in almost all residential
settings and some commercial; both systems are tested to 0.74kN at 1.2m post centres.

## Stylish aluminium railing, balustrade & fencing

**Marano® is the stylish and premium range of aluminium solutions from F.H.Brundle. Marano’s
extensive range primarily consists of aluminium railings, fencing and balustrade systems designed to
integrate perfectly into high-end outside spaces. **

Crafted and engineered from quality aluminium, Marano fence boards and the **Marano Integrated**
fencing system offer affordable, durable luxury for external perimeters. This range offers aesthetic
solutions for outdoor living that compliments elegant, modern design and provides practicality,
durability and sustainability.

The Marano railings range, consisting of **Marano Simplicity **and **Marano Blade**, introduces two
systems capable of seamlessly working in most residential settings – premium aluminium powder coated
in a black matte finish for timeless elegance. Whilst Simplicity offers affordable, simple style for
gardens, patios and pools, Blade is a railing solution that provides differing levels of privacy
alongside contemporary design.

Truly versatile handrail/balustrade systems are hard to come by, but **Marano Curve** and **Marano
Edge** are a rare and practical find. Combining the qualities of anodised aluminium and the strength
of tempered glass, both post-and-glass balustrade systems can be utilised in almost all residential
settings and some commercial; both systems are tested to 0.74kN at 1.2m post centres.

# Composite Fence Design Innovator & WPC Manufacturer

Trusted by 50+ Countries Since 2014. Your One-Stop Fencing Solution.

[ ORDER FREE SAMPLES ][37]

## Empowering Distributors with Factory-Direct Pricing & Custom Design Solutions

(WPC, ASA, and Advanced Materials)
Since 2014, MecoFence has been the trusted source for composite fencing production. We deliver
ISO-certified, wind-resistant outdoor systems to contractors and wholesalers in over 50 countries.

In-House Design & R&D Co-Extrusion & Testing OEM / Private Label Modular System

### In-House Design & R&D

Our own design team releases original profiles every year — the dual-tone 3D fluted board,
wide-format privacy board and more. Exclusive designs your competitors can't source, so you compete
on design, not discount.
* Original, patented designs — not commodity boards
* New profiles & textures released annually
* Full ODM — we cut exclusive molds for your market

[ Explore Designs ][38]
[MecoFence composite fence board profiles — solid, wide privacy, aluminum carved screen, fluted and
hollow-core interlocking boards in teak and dark grey]

### Co-Extrusion & Testing

Our fence boards are co-extruded with a 1mm cap and tested against the failures that come back from
the field — so what you ship stays standing and looking new. Fewer callbacks, your reputation
protected.
* 1mm co-extruded cap — vs the 0.3–0.5mm industry standard
* Category-7 wind-rated, 3,500N bend-tested
* [ 8-step QC + boiling, freeze-thaw & UV testing ][39]

[ View Test Reports ][40]
[3,500N bending strength test on a MecoFence composite fence board, verifying Category-7 wind
resistance]

### OEM / Private Label

Put your brand on a product no one else can copy. Your logo on panels, packaging, sample kits and
catalogs — the premium stays yours, not a reseller's cut.
* Your logo on panels, boxes, sample kits & catalogs
* MOQ 100 sets standard · custom colors (RAL / Pantone) from 200 sets
* Build your own brand — protect your margin

[ Become a Distributor ][41]
[MecoFence OEM / private-label distributor kit — movable display rack, component samples, product
brochures, sample boxes, standing displays and portable mini collection]

### Complete Modular System

Boards, posts, caps, rails and hardware ship as one interlocking system that slots together fast —
lower labor for your crews, no missing parts on site.
* Tongue-and-groove interlocking — installs up to 30% faster
* Complete system: boards + posts + caps + rails + hardware
* Aluminum or WPC posts, slope-adjustable

[ See the System ][42]
[Mecofence flute composite fence installation diagram showing an exploded view of components
including post bases, rails, and interlocking slats.]

## Low Maintenance Modular Fencing System

### Modern Composite Fencing

Features trellis & decorative screens. A low-maintenance design engineered for superior wind
resistance.

[ View Series ][43]

### Co-extrusion PVC Fence

Offers 100% privacy with essential airflow. Proven to have higher strength than normal vinyl fences.

[ View Series ][44]

### Fence Gate & Light

Custom double swing gates compatible with electric automation. Complete with integrated post
lighting.

[ View Series ][45]

## Composite Fence by MecoFence

A wide selection of high-quality fencing materials and styles suit every need and ensure the perfect
match for your home, garden, or commercial space.

## About Us

Welcome to MLT wholesale Vinyl fence and deck supplier, we are proud to present our premium vinyl
products to home owners and contractors at a very reasonable price.  


We are the largest Vinyl Fence dealer in Southern Saskatchewan.

 

Our premium brand vinyl fencing are:
* Made with high quality virgin vinyl (not recycled)
* Bottom rail is reinforced with an aluminum I-Bean, eliminating sagging
* Interlock Panel for a better hold
* Low Maintenance. No more painting or staining!
* Will not stain or yellow. Our products contains 10% Dupont Titanium Dioxide(TiO2) and UV
  inhibitors
* Mildew resistant
* Meet ASTM Certifications
* Stronger fence  
  * Post thickness 0.150"
  * Panel thickness 0.051" 
  * Rail thickness 0.080"
  * Rails are 2" X 6" 

 

Full limited lifetime warranty!

# Welcome to Mulligan Fencing

We are a large-scale supply & installation fencing contractor for all types of fencing projects
across the UK & Ireland. With over 27 years’ experience of fencing, we have the resource and ability
to complete any construction project, no matter how big or small.

Typically, we supply and install fences along Motorways, Highways, Railways, Farmlands, Business
Premises, Sport Fields and Private Residences. We’ve an extensive range of fencing such as
Environmental Noise Barriers (which are CE Marked to standard 14388:2005),

Timber Post and Rail, Strained Wire Fencing, Security Fencing (which includes Weldmesh, Palisade and
Chainlink), Railings, Estate Fencing, Hoarding and Sports Fencing. We also have gates to compliment
each type of fence along with a variety of colours.

With our large fleet of machinery and over 70 experienced and dedicated employees, our customers can
be sure that we will deliver to budget and on time, without compromising on quality. We have the
skills to cope with any terrain from hard rocky ground to soft wet bog land.

news, and more.

company status.

Galvanized Steel (GI) or PVC Coated Wire, our [chain link fence][33] can be cut to size based on
your requirements.

[ Explore More ][34]

Wire Mesh Fencing (FAV)

Also known as V pressed fence that has a unique V shape on the mesh panel & offers a stylish design.
Perfect for areas like schools, farming and stadiums. Our range of [wire mesh fencing][35] includes
[wire netting][36] and mesh for creating basic partitions. 100% tested & coated for high weather
resistance.

[ Explore More ][37]

Angle Bars

A steel material which has an L shape with inside radius corners of different sizes. It is ideal in
many structural applications because of its economical cost. Can be found in our everyday life items
like shelves, chairs, sheds, pillars and many, ironworks product.

[ Explore More ][38]

Barbed Wires

Can be used as a fence for perimeter or used along with chain link fence with barbed wire on the
top. It can usually be used with angle bars or hollow post . There are 2 type of barbed wires
available, PVC coated and GI wire.

[ Explore More ][39]

BRC

A steel reinforcement material in concrete. It consists of a series of high strength wires welded
together to form a square or rectangular grids fabric. Some of applications are - reinforcement of
slab, retaining wall, precast building components security cages and etc.

[ Explore More ][40]

Flat Bars, Round Bars, Deformed Bars

Comes with a wide choice of metal and structural steel products — including round, flat & deformed
bars. All come in various thicknesses, sizes and grades with a custom cut to size service. 100%
tested & at proven ISO and OEM standards.

[ Explore More ][41]

Gabion & Mattress

A cage-like mesh used to fill rocks and concrete. It is used to control soil corrosion, dam usage,
draining usage and also as a foundation of construction. The gabion comes in hot-dipped galvanized
or PVC coated.

[ Explore More ][42]

Hollow Pipes

Comes with range like GI pipes, ultragal pipes, and also black pipes. These pipes can be used for
hollow post, or for distribution of treated or raw water in rural or urban areas. They are also
economical, lightweight and very easy to handle.

[ Explore More ][43]

Hollow Sections

Hollow sections is a type of metal profile that comes in two type: square and rectangle. Its
standard length is 6m and is widely used in ironworks project.

[ Explore More ][44]

Razor Barbed Wires

Can be used as a fence for perimeter or used along with chain link fence with barbed wire on the
top. Available in 2 options, including PVC coated & Galvanized Steel (GI) wire.

## About Us

Perimeter Security Solutions (PSS) was established in 2018 with a commitment to revolutionizing the
field of perimeter defense. Our origins are rooted in a deep understanding of both the strengths and
vulnerabilities of high-security systems, informed by extensive field experience.

Our signature products, the IFI-12 and IFI-14 fully welded fencing systems, are at the core of our
innovation. These systems have set new industry standards for durability and effectiveness, having
been rigorously tested and proven to outperform other market offerings in challenging scenarios.

At PSS, our mission extends beyond conventional solutions. We are actively expanding our portfolio
to include innovative technology solutions for perimeter security, aiming to provide a complete and
integrated solution to address a broad spectrum of threats. This move marks a significant step in
our journey towards offering a comprehensive, rapid-deployment security system that combines
advanced physical and electronic components.

Innovation is the heart of our operations. We’re proud to hold several design patents for our
barrier systems, reflecting our commitment to continuous innovation and excellence in the field of
perimeter security. Join us as we redefine security standards and lead the charge into a safer
future with 100% US. Steel and American-Made Manufacturing.

##### systems that stand the test of time. Today, we’re rising stronger — with renewed leadership,
##### smarter systems, and an unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and service.

family, and faith in what’s possible. From our Florida headquarters to our Georgia and North
Carolina facilities, every product that carries the Poly Vinyl Creations name represents hard work,
honesty, and the courage to evolve. Our journey hasn’t been easy — but neither is strength. What
began as a small family operation has transformed into a full-scale manufacturing and distribution
network committed to innovation, safety, and lasting partnerships.

# Supplying, anti-climb, industrial and security fencing Australia Wide

## **YOUR TRUSTED PARTNER IN SECURITY FENCING SOLUTIONS **

Protective Fencing is the leading supplier of cutting-edge high security, chainwire and anti-climb
fencing solutions. Our products are used for Commercial, Residential, Industrial and Government
Infrastructure projects throughout Australia.
With over 50 years supplying the fencing industry, we specialise in delivering high-quality security
fencing products, innovative designs, and tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of our
clients.
Our one-stop service offering, is flexible and covers every step of the value chain, including early
design, feasibility, sampling, production, transport, installation partners.
Products include 358 Anti-Climb Fencing, Palisade Fencing, Chain Wire Fencing, Weld Mesh fencing and
Custom fabrication. Protective Fencing provide safe, efficient, and cost-effective security fencing
solutions.

# Supplying, anti-climb, industrial and security fencing Australia Wide

## **YOUR TRUSTED PARTNER IN SECURITY FENCING SOLUTIONS **

Protective Fencing is the leading supplier of cutting-edge high security, chainwire and anti-climb
fencing solutions. Our products are used for Commercial, Residential, Industrial and Government
Infrastructure projects throughout Australia.
With over 50 years supplying the fencing industry, we specialise in delivering high-quality security
fencing products, innovative designs, and tailored solutions to meet the unique needs of our
clients.
Our one-stop service offering, is flexible and covers every step of the value chain, including early
design, feasibility, sampling, production, transport, installation partners.
Products include 358 Anti-Climb Fencing, Palisade Fencing, Chain Wire Fencing, Weld Mesh fencing and
Custom fabrication. Protective Fencing provide safe, efficient, and cost-effective security fencing
solutions.

## FAQ's

[ Do we install fences during the winter?
][95]

Yes, we install fences all year round, including during the winter months. As long as the ground
isn’t deeply frozen or snow accumulation isn’t too severe, winter installations are entirely
possible. In fact, scheduling during the off-season can often mean shorter wait times.

[ Do we handle utility marking and property line verification?
][96]

Yes, we handle utility marking by contacting the local utility locating services before
installation. However, we do not verify property lines. It is the **homeowners responsibility to
confirm property boundaries**, typically through recent survey or official property documents.

[ Do we offer free estimates?
][97]

Yes, we provide free, no- obligation estimates for all fencing projects. One of our estimators will
visit your property, assess the area, discuss your goals, and provide a detailed quote. You can
schedule your free estimate by calling us directly at [812-232-9904][98], filling out the form on
our website, or emailing us at [qualityfence@joink.com][99]

[ Do we offer repairs?
][100]

Yes, we offer fence repair services for all types of fences, including wood, vinyl, chain link and
aluminum. Whether it’s a broken picket, leaning post, sagging gate or storm damage, our team can
assess the issue and provide a solution to restore your fence’s function and appearance.

[ Do I need a permit to install a fence?
][101]

Permit requirements vary based on your location. It is important to check with your local zoning
department to determine if a permit is necessary for your project.

Yes, we provide free, no- obligation estimates for all fencing projects. One of our estimators will
visit your property, assess the area, discuss your goals, and provide a detailed quote. You can
schedule your free estimate by calling us directly at [812-232-9904][98], filling out the form on
our website, or emailing us at [qualityfence@joink.com][99]

[ Do we offer repairs?
][100]

Yes, we offer fence repair services for all types of fences, including wood, vinyl, chain link and
aluminum. Whether it’s a broken picket, leaning post, sagging gate or storm damage, our team can
assess the issue and provide a solution to restore your fence’s function and appearance.

[ Do I need a permit to install a fence?
][101]

Permit requirements vary based on your location. It is important to check with your local zoning
department to determine if a permit is necessary for your project.

systems. Serving Northeast Oklahoma, Tulsa, and beyond, we combine craftsmanship, premium materials,
and local expertise to deliver fences that protect your family with privacy and security.

# Building on Tradition

Red Brand is a line of premium agricultural fencing products and reigns as the most recognized brand
of farm fence in the United States. The Red Brand logo represents 130 years of making top quality,
fence products for a wide variety of applications. Whether you’re a full-time farmer or rancher,
horse or property owner, Red Brand stands as the product of choice when selecting the best. We
proudly bear the title of ‘The most respected name in farm fence.’

[About Red Brand][71]

## Fence Products

We know what’s in our products and we have the steel to prove it. Our wire is precisely formulated
and carefully monitored at the same plant where our fence is made. Having complete control of the
process helps eliminate impurities and maintain specific alloy formulas. As a result, every vertical
and horizontal wire reacts the same to pressure and harsh weather conditions. This means that the
entire structure will stretch properly at install and react consistently with temperature changes.
In contrast, if the chemistry isn’t perfect, inclusions can cause inconsistent tensile strength. A
fence assembled with uncertain steel origins or chemistry will likely result in a fence that sags,
breaks, or fails prematurely.

# Building on Tradition

Red Brand is a line of premium agricultural fencing products and reigns as the most recognized brand
of farm fence in the United States. The Red Brand logo represents 130 years of making top quality,
fence products for a wide variety of applications. Whether you’re a full-time farmer or rancher,
horse or property owner, Red Brand stands as the product of choice when selecting the best. We
proudly bear the title of ‘The most respected name in farm fence.’

[About Red Brand][71]

## Fence Products

We know what’s in our products and we have the steel to prove it. Our wire is precisely formulated
and carefully monitored at the same plant where our fence is made. Having complete control of the
process helps eliminate impurities and maintain specific alloy formulas. As a result, every vertical
and horizontal wire reacts the same to pressure and harsh weather conditions. This means that the
entire structure will stretch properly at install and react consistently with temperature changes.
In contrast, if the chemistry isn’t perfect, inclusions can cause inconsistent tensile strength. A
fence assembled with uncertain steel origins or chemistry will likely result in a fence that sags,
breaks, or fails prematurely.

## WHICH FENCE MATERIAL IS BEST FOR YOU?

[[wood-fence-icon.png]][33]

[Wood Fence][34]
* Pros: Wooden fences offer a traditional look, are great for privacy, and have an endless variety
  of color choices.
* Cons: Wood fences require maintenance such as painting or staining and can have higher prices for
  materials.

[[iron-fence-icon.png]][35]

Aluminum Fence
* Pros: Aluminum fences are low maintenance, comparatively inexpensive, versatile, and durable.
* Cons: Aluminum fences lack privacy and are comparatively weaker for security purposes.

[[chain-link-fence-icon.png]][36]

[][37]Chain Link Fence
* Pros: Chain link fences are affordable, low maintenance, and keep kids and pets in.
* Cons: Chain link fences are less secure, lack privacy, and can be less aesthetically pleasing.

Vinyl PVC Fence
* Pros: Vinyl fences are low maintenance, easy to install, not affected by pests or rot, and boast a
  long life.
* Cons: PVC fences are less strong than wood or chain link, less secure since pieces aren't attached
  by nails or screws, and may crack or break in extreme heat.

With over 43 years in the fencing industry, SCS understands the needs of our customers –
contractors, project managers and event planners – and is committed to exceeding expectations with
expertly designed products, exceptional service and the fastest response time. From temporary
fencing to standard and custom wholesale products, SCS offers a complete line of the highest quality
fencing options for construction, events, emergency services, safety and security.

What materials do you sell?

We sell vinyl, aluminum and pressure treated fences. 

 

In the near future we will be offering chain link and possibly cedar as well.

Yes!  Give us a call or text at 856-595-4553 and we'll get you started.

We just need your name, company name, phone, email, and proof of owning the company.

Do you charge for credit cards?

Nope!  Use your credit cards and rack up those points or cash back!

Do you offer jobsite delivery?

Yes!  We deliver up to 2 hours from our warehouse which is located at 675s Evergreen Ave in Woodbury

treated fences are available same day!

No, Subscribr is annual billing only.

Annual billing keeps your price lower and gives you all your credits upfront so you can create at
your own pace. It also lets us reinvest into what actually grows your channel: strategy calls, video
trainings, frameworks, and workflow templates. You get more value per dollar; we get the stability

full walkthrough][11]. And if you get stuck, email us—we'll help.

Yes. The same content principles work for small and big channels. One creator grew to 10,000
subscribers in 30 days using Subscribr plus consistent publishing.

### Will this work for my type of YouTube channel?

Yes! Subscribr works great for faceless channels, tutorials, documentaries, reviews, story-based
videos, business channels and more.

ideas, outlines, and draft scripts, then do a quick polish in their native language.

# High Quality Fencing System for Your Projects [Contact Us][28]

[ [Slide]][29]

## Panel Fence

Our panel fences are our most-exported fencing solutions. Easily installable, aesthetic with the
possibility of custom design, rigid panel fences are widely used for homes, construction sites,
public and private spaces. [Read More ][30]
[ [Slide]][31]

## High Security Fence

Specially designed for high security and protection of administrations, systems installations, plans
(sensitive areas, public areas, publics…). The panels are between 150 cm and 300 cm, the minimum of
the wires is 5 to 6 mm, the mesh of the panels is 10 mm. [Read More ][32]
[ [Slide]][33]

## Temporary Fence

Temporary and portable fences are intended to secure spaces for a limited period of time. These
systems can be quickly installed and dismantled to be reused for the protection of construction
sites or spaces that host events such as cultural activities and concerts. [Read More ][34]

## About

TE-FENCE is a production and export trademark of the TMEC INTERNATIONAL group, based in Istanbul,
Turkey.

TE-FENCE specializes in the design, production and exportation of fencing systems such as flexible
fences (simple or double torsion mesh), rigid panel fences, temporary fences for worksites,
concertina wire, barbed wire, gates and doors, as well as fencing systems for sports facilities.

## Engineered for Performance and Lasting Beauty

## Why Homeowners Choose Trex® Fencing
* True privacy — interlocking pickets create a continuous, gap-free screen.
* Neighbor-friendly — same refined finish on both sides (perfect for backyard shared lines and HOA
  perimeters).
* Low maintenance — no painting or staining; won’t rot, peel, or splinter like wood.
* Wind-ready — engineered system designed to stay stable through gusty conditions.
* Softer sound — solid composite panels help dampen street and backyard noise.
* Fits your property — sections step or rake neatly on slopes and can mount as wall toppers on
  block/brick walls.
* Pool-friendly — composite won’t corrode around splash or salt-system water.
* Style choice — vertical **Seclusions**, horizontal **Horizons** & **Solitudes**, and
  **Shenandoah** rail fencing for open-view ranch and perimeter looks.
* Sustainable — made with the highest recycled content; long service life reduces replacement waste.
* Peace of mind — 25-year limited residential warranty.

## Trex® Composite & Rail Fencing — A Quick Overview

If you’re comparing fence options for the first time, Trex makes it simple: you get **true privacy**
and a **finished look on both sides** without the constant upkeep of wood. The interlocking pickets
in our privacy fence systems slide into rails to form a solid, gap-free screen so the yard feels
private and calm from day one.

Pick the style that fits your home: **Seclusions** (classic vertical privacy), **Horizons** or
**Solitudes** (modern horizontal privacy), or **Shenandoah** rail fencing for open-view ranch and
perimeter lines. Sections follow the lay of the land—raking or stepping across slopes—and can be
mounted as **wall toppers** on existing block or brick for added height and privacy. Around pools,
Trex’s composite boards and coated components stand up to splash and salt-system environments.

Day-to-day living is easier: there’s **no painting or staining**, and the boards won’t rot, peel, or
splinter like wood and the 25-year residential limited warranty from the world's leading outdoor
living manufacturer gives you peace of mind.

## Our Story

Trex Fencing has been in people’s backyards since 2005.

In 1989, what started out to be an installation company, FDS Distributors, began installing
primarily wood fencing and decking. Then, in 1996, a revolutionary composite decking product was
introduced to the market by TREX. Trex composite materials are made from 95% recycled plastic and
wood, creating a board that has the strength of wood with the low-maintenance virtues of plastic.
Trex composite boards do not require annual painting and staining, do not rot or decay, and continue
to look beautiful over time.

FDS became an early adopter of the Trex composite materials, and it quickly became their go-to
product for decking. FDS noticed quickly that customer satisfaction and the longevity of Trex
decking were significantly better than those of wood decks and fences. Eight years later, FDS
approached Trex with the idea of making a fencing product using the same composite materials they
were currently using for Trex decking.

For the next two years, FDS worked with Trex to develop a composite fencing system that looked like
their most popular wood fence. It looks great on both sides and, just like Trex composite decking,
it does not rot or decay and does not need annual painting or staining. In 2005, FDS installed the
first-ever Trex Seclusions Fence.

For twenty years, FDS Distributors has been the national distributor and partner with Trex,
supplying customers across the United States and Canada with Trex fencing. FDS continues to grow and
develop its partnership with Trex by bringing new and exciting fence products to the market. Please
check out our newest patent-pending product, exclusively designed and distributed by FDS: the Trex
Rail Fence, Shenandoah.

# Trex Fencing

## Engineered for Performance and Lasting Beauty

## Why Homeowners Choose Trex® Fencing
* True privacy — interlocking pickets create a continuous, gap-free screen.
* Neighbor-friendly — same refined finish on both sides (perfect for backyard shared lines and HOA
  perimeters).
* Low maintenance — no painting or staining; won’t rot, peel, or splinter like wood.
* Wind-ready — engineered system designed to stay stable through gusty conditions.
* Softer sound — solid composite panels help dampen street and backyard noise.
* Fits your property — sections step or rake neatly on slopes and can mount as wall toppers on
  block/brick walls.
* Pool-friendly — composite won’t corrode around splash or salt-system water.
* Style choice — vertical **Seclusions**, horizontal **Horizons** & **Solitudes**, and
  **Shenandoah** rail fencing for open-view ranch and perimeter looks.
* Sustainable — made with the highest recycled content; long service life reduces replacement waste.
* Peace of mind — 25-year limited residential warranty.

## Trex® Composite & Rail Fencing — A Quick Overview

If you’re comparing fence options for the first time, Trex makes it simple: you get **true privacy**
and a **finished look on both sides** without the constant upkeep of wood. The interlocking pickets
in our privacy fence systems slide into rails to form a solid, gap-free screen so the yard feels
private and calm from day one.

Pick the style that fits your home: **Seclusions** (classic vertical privacy), **Horizons** or
**Solitudes** (modern horizontal privacy), or **Shenandoah** rail fencing for open-view ranch and
perimeter lines. Sections follow the lay of the land—raking or stepping across slopes—and can be
mounted as **wall toppers** on existing block or brick for added height and privacy. Around pools,
Trex’s composite boards and coated components stand up to splash and salt-system environments.

Day-to-day living is easier: there’s **no painting or staining**, and the boards won’t rot, peel, or
splinter like wood and the 25-year residential limited warranty from the world's leading outdoor
living manufacturer gives you peace of mind.

## Our Story

Trex Fencing has been in people’s backyards since 2005.

In 1989, what started out to be an installation company, FDS Distributors, began installing
primarily wood fencing and decking. Then, in 1996, a revolutionary composite decking product was
introduced to the market by TREX. Trex composite materials are made from 95% recycled plastic and
wood, creating a board that has the strength of wood with the low-maintenance virtues of plastic.
Trex composite boards do not require annual painting and staining, do not rot or decay, and continue
to look beautiful over time.

FDS became an early adopter of the Trex composite materials, and it quickly became their go-to
product for decking. FDS noticed quickly that customer satisfaction and the longevity of Trex
decking were significantly better than those of wood decks and fences. Eight years later, FDS
approached Trex with the idea of making a fencing product using the same composite materials they
were currently using for Trex decking.

For the next two years, FDS worked with Trex to develop a composite fencing system that looked like
their most popular wood fence. It looks great on both sides and, just like Trex composite decking,
it does not rot or decay and does not need annual painting or staining. In 2005, FDS installed the
first-ever Trex Seclusions Fence.

For twenty years, FDS Distributors has been the national distributor and partner with Trex,
supplying customers across the United States and Canada with Trex fencing. FDS continues to grow and
develop its partnership with Trex by bringing new and exciting fence products to the market. Please
check out our newest patent-pending product, exclusively designed and distributed by FDS: the Trex
Rail Fence, Shenandoah.

## MAXIMALE BEWEGLICHKEIT BEI JEDEM SCHRITT

**FECHTSCHUH KEMPA “PRO AGILITY”**

Explosiv, schnell, präzise – der moderne Fechtsport stellt höchste Anforderungen an Schuhwerk. Der
Kempa PRO AGILITY wurde genau dafür entwickelt: Für maximale Stabilität, reaktionsschnelles Abrollen
und optimale Performance auf der Fechtbahn.

Mit seinem innovativen Aufbau, der aus dem Profihandball stammt und für den Fechtsport neu
interpretiert wurde, bietet der PRO AGILITY ein Höchstmaß an Dämpfung, Grip und Kontrolle – perfekt
für intensive Gefechte und blitzschnelle Richtungswechsel.

Die Highlights des Kempa PRO AGILITY im Überblick:
* Neopren-Sockenkonstruktion mit Einschlupflasche für einfaches Anziehen und sicheren Halt
* Rutschfeste Mikrofaser im Vorfuß und gepolsterter Rückfuß für Stabilität bei hohen Belastungen
* Torsion System – sorgt für eine gezielte Mittelfußstabilisierung
* PU-Dämpfungspads an Ferse und Ballen für optimalen Rebound bei Ausfallschritten
* Hochgezogene Gummisohle – schützt das Obermaterial vor Abrieb und erhöht die Lebensdauer
* Integrierte Schutzlasche für langlebige Schnürung ohne Verschleiß
* Abgerundete Fersensohle für dynamisches Abrollen bei Vorwärts- und Rückwärtsbewegungen
* Ultraleichtes, atmungsaktives Mesh für hohen Tragekomfort und Feuchtigkeitstransport
* Maximale Stabilität bei minimalem Gewicht
* Spezialsohle mit optimalem Grip für kontrollierte Bewegungen auf der Bahn
* Ergonomisch geformte Laufsohle für natürliche Abrollbewegung und volle Bewegungsfreiheit
* Erhältlich in den Größen 36 (UK 3,5) – 48 (UK 13)


Bereit, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten? Dann ist der Kempa PRO AGILITY dein nächster Schritt.

## MAXIMALE BEWEGLICHKEIT BEI JEDEM SCHRITT

**FECHTSCHUH KEMPA “PRO AGILITY”**

Explosiv, schnell, präzise – der moderne Fechtsport stellt höchste Anforderungen an Schuhwerk. Der
Kempa PRO AGILITY wurde genau dafür entwickelt: Für maximale Stabilität, reaktionsschnelles Abrollen
und optimale Performance auf der Fechtbahn.

Mit seinem innovativen Aufbau, der aus dem Profihandball stammt und für den Fechtsport neu
interpretiert wurde, bietet der PRO AGILITY ein Höchstmaß an Dämpfung, Grip und Kontrolle – perfekt
für intensive Gefechte und blitzschnelle Richtungswechsel.

Die Highlights des Kempa PRO AGILITY im Überblick:
* Neopren-Sockenkonstruktion mit Einschlupflasche für einfaches Anziehen und sicheren Halt
* Rutschfeste Mikrofaser im Vorfuß und gepolsterter Rückfuß für Stabilität bei hohen Belastungen
* Torsion System – sorgt für eine gezielte Mittelfußstabilisierung
* PU-Dämpfungspads an Ferse und Ballen für optimalen Rebound bei Ausfallschritten
* Hochgezogene Gummisohle – schützt das Obermaterial vor Abrieb und erhöht die Lebensdauer
* Integrierte Schutzlasche für langlebige Schnürung ohne Verschleiß
* Abgerundete Fersensohle für dynamisches Abrollen bei Vorwärts- und Rückwärtsbewegungen
* Ultraleichtes, atmungsaktives Mesh für hohen Tragekomfort und Feuchtigkeitstransport
* Maximale Stabilität bei minimalem Gewicht
* Spezialsohle mit optimalem Grip für kontrollierte Bewegungen auf der Bahn
* Ergonomisch geformte Laufsohle für natürliche Abrollbewegung und volle Bewegungsfreiheit
* Erhältlich in den Größen 36 (UK 3,5) – 48 (UK 13)


Bereit, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten? Dann ist der Kempa PRO AGILITY dein nächster Schritt.
